notes: attempt-1 was exploratory (variable listing, no RESULT lines). Final script translates 1_main_tables.do Table 3 (DscoreraceIAT on mixracebas, lagged round-1 DscoreraceIAT, own and roommate controls, Res_base FE; round 2, whites/blacks) and Table 4 (GPA, examspassed, continue, PCAperf on mixracebas, controls, Res_base + regprogram FE for whites/blacks; full sample adds white/coloured/Else dummies and blackRes + whiteRes + Res_base + regprogram FE) using fixest::feols with fixef.rm='none' and SEs clustered by roomnum_base, on uctdata_balanced.dta. The do-file's 'roconsbas_miss' is a Stata abbreviation of the dataset variable roconsbas_missing, used here. Collinear dummies (foreign_missing, privateschool_miss, and white/Else in the full sample, absorbed by the race x residence FE) are dropped by fixest, as Stata would omit them. All 13 RESULT values match the claimed values at the reported precision; no claim-driven revisions were made. The run was done in a scratch directory and the files copied here.
